instruction: Fix `flatten` in `seqops/transforms.py` so it flattens arbitrarily deeply nested lists. It currently flattens only one level, so nested sublists survive in the output instead of being recursively unwrapped.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/transforms.py b/seqops/transforms.py
--- a/seqops/transforms.py
+++ b/seqops/transforms.py
@@ -43,7 +43,7 @@
     result = []
     for item in nested:
         if isinstance(item, list):
-            result.extend(item)
+            result.extend(flatten(item))
         else:
             result.append(item)
     return result
